balls.text: a poor finish from Aaron, a full toss on the pads, Yusuf flicks and flicks with power, hitting it in front of square. Yusuf's had a poor IPL season but he's come good today.
a full toss and Yusuf has dispatched it again, placing it into the gap on the cover boundary
Warner's dropped a catch on the long-on boundary! He came running to his left to intercept a flat and powerful smash from Yusuf and ended up parrying it for a one bounce for
a short ball and Shukla tries to pull, he connects with the bottom of the bat and mis-times it towards cow corner, Taylor tries to pick up with one hand but fumbles
a full toss outside off stump, the yorker gone wrong, Shukla makes room and smashes it past extra cover and into the gap
only Warner can stop this one and he does! Yusuf smashed the ball hard and straight, Warner came sprinting to his right from long off and dived full length, stopping the boundary in the nick of time
a full ball outside off, Yusuf drives past extra cover and this time the ball goes wide enough of long off to allow the second, even Warner could not stop it
in the blockhole outside off, Shukla moved outside the off stump to try and glance the ball past short fine leg but he did not connect properly
a short ball and Shukla has made tremendous contact with the pull off the front foot, launching it far into the stands at square leg
Shukla made room by moving towards the leg side and this time he had room, and so he freed his arms and blasted the ball over extra cover, one-bounce four
Shukla moved towards the leg side but Morkel followed him with a fast, low full toss and beat the batsman, the ball went between leg stump and the batsman
a full toss and Yusuf's put it away, swinging across the line and placing the ball into the gap at cow corner
that's too wide outside off stump, Yusuf reached for it with a wild swing but the ball was too far away
the quick short ball speeds past Yusuf's attempted hook
in the blockhole outside off, Shukla backed away and dug it out on the off side
good length outside off stump, and quick, Shukla tries to cut but misses
short ball and Shukla was ready and waiting, he made room by moving towards leg and pulled with power into the gap at deep midwicket
length ball outside off, Yusuf pulls and hits it to long on along the ground, Umesh's pace is keeping Yusuf in his crease
in the blockhole this time, Yusuf tries to force through midwicket but gets an inside edge towards the keeper's left
that's the right length to Yusuf, short of a length outside off, Yusuf tries to carve behind point but is beaten
length ball outside off stump and that's in Yusuf's hitting zone, he frees his arms and swings with might, carting the ball over the straight boundary
full ball outside off and Shukla drives to wide long-off. Had it been anyone else in the Delhi team, the batsmen could have run two, but it was Warner and he was so quick
full and wide outside off, Yusuf square drives through point
Yusuf swings hard at a good length ball outside off but connects with nothing

caught at deep midwicket! Kallis got a length ball and he swiveled-pulled it straight to Taylor on the boundary. A simple catch and Kallis is gone without accelerating the innings. A strike-rate of 91

Yusuf fails to connect with the pull, the length wasn't short enough and he was hurried by the pace. Yusuf got hit on the shoulder off the edge and the ball dropped on the pitch. Kallis called Yusuf through for a single and Yusuf beat the direct hit from the keeper
full ball outside off, Kallis square drives to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
nearly in the blockhole, played back to the bowler

in the air but through the gap! Kallis drove a length ball on the up, reaching away from his body to hit it flat and past the fielder at extra cover. Nadeem, who is on the field from Irfan, was at long off and he could not cut if off
good length and straight from Umesh, Yusuf swats it towards long-on, hit along the ground
a fast full toss at thigh height, Yusuf swings it through midwicket but Venugopal runs to his left, covers good ground, and dives to save the boundary
short of a length at the body, Yusuf pulls behind square, towards long leg
short of a length outside off, Kallis stays back and cuts towards third man
fuller ball angling into the right-hander, Yusuf dabs the ball towards midwicket
a quick ball on a good length outside off, Yusuf tries to cut but misses
length ball on the pads, Yusuf missed the glance, the ball brushed his pad and Ojha dived to his left to collect. That was there to put away
good length angling across the right-hander, played from the crease to point
good length and straight, Yusuf just taps it on the leg side and runs
caught behind! Shakib tried to cut without moving his feet much, the short of a length ball from Irfan was much too close to the left-hander and Shakib got a faint edge, he walked in fact
full and straight, Kallis drives to long-on
Shakib jumps out of his crease and drives a length ball along the ground to deep cover, where Taylor fields
Kallis drives the length ball angling across him behind point
Shakib goes back to nudge on the leg side but doesn't make contact
nudged off the pads to short fine leg

caught at point! McCullum charged the bowler but did not get to the pitch of the ball, he threw his bat at it but ended up slicing high in the air towards Warner, who pedaled back and judged the catch well. McCullum was done in by the turn, which forced the outside edge
he tries to play the reverse sweep but it did not come off
that's been hit far into the stands beyond the deep midwicket boundary. McCullum came forward, got down on one knee and heaved across the line, making stupendous contact
tight line and length, on middle and off, McCullum defends
driven to long off for a single
a low full toss on the pads, Kallis flicks through square
Umesh strays on to the pads with his fine leg in the circle, he holds his head in anguish after Kallis glances him for four
pulled off the back foot between midwicket and mid on
McCullum jumps out of his crease but then has to wait for a slower delivery, he cuts towards point
Kallis steps out and drives a length ball from Umesh through cover point
Kallis tries to sweep but misses once again, he gets hit on the pad, the impact was outside off
Kallis goes back and defends awkwardly, that stayed low and was quicker
Kallis tries to reverse sweep with the spin but misses and is hit on the pad
Kallis gets beaten by one that spins and bounces away from him after pitching on off stump
McCullum gets down on one knee and sweeps to deep square leg
short ball outside off from the left-arm spinner from round the wicket, Kallis goes back and hits in front of point
good length on leg and middle, Kallis flicks from his crease through square
good length on off stump, played off the back foot on the off side

dropped, Kallis drove the length ball hard and straight at Irfan, who tried to catch it to his right on his follow through but couldn't hang on. It was a very tough chance for Kallis hit it very hard. Irfan's cut his right hand as well. Lots of blood.
played from the crease to Warner at point

Taylor went for the catch, but in the end he did not reach it and couldn't not prevent the ball bouncing past him to the deep midwicket boundary. The ball was short again and this time Kallis pulled, hitting it flat but in the air. Taylor came running in and slid, but the ball fell short of him and skidded past
short of a length from over the wicket, Kallis tries to pull but gets an inside edge on to the body
short of length, pushed to the covers and they want to go for a quick single, Kallis is slow off the blocks, and Warner throws it to the non-striker's stumps, misses. Looked close had it hit
on the leg side, quickly nudged away to short fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, puts his foot out and drives to deep cover for a single
on the middle, no turn this time, inside edge to short fine-leg
full-toss, on the off stump, driven down the ground for a single
outside the off stump, shorter from the bowler, cut away to extra-cover for a couple of runs
slower one from Pathan, tries to cut it away, but it bounces a little more than what the batsman expected, misses and through to the keeper
short of length, outside the off stump, cut away to deep covers for a single
on the off stump, length ball and McCullum was walking down, before pushing it to the covers, quick call of "No"
outside the off stump, this time it is pitched further up, Kallis had to reach out for it for the drive, gets an inside edge to square-leg for a single
on the leg stump, short of length yet again, played away to fine-leg for a single
on the off stump, no swing, short of length, opens the face of the bat to third-man
another one pitched up from the left-arm spinner, Kallis deftly plays it to the off side and they are off for a single
outside the off stump, on a length and driven to short covers
on the leg stump, pushed to square-leg for a single
pitched up on the middle again, and he tries to reverse sweep it, misses and there is an appeal, not-out
pitched right up, on the leg stump, driven to long-on for a single
turn immediately! round the stumps, pitched on middle and turned viciously!
outside the off stump, slower from Aaron, the cut goes hard into the ground to the point fielder

full-toss outside the off stump, punched to mid-off, is this run-out? That  is out, this is out of the blue, a bonus wicket for sure, Gambhir looking in form, but for some reason he did not come back soon enough to his crease after being sent back and the direct hit finds him short!
on the off stump, short of length, 143.7 km/hr, opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single
flayed away through the covers for a four this time, pitched slightly up, makes it into a drivable length by jumping down the track and drilling it through!
mistimed for a six! That was another short ball from Aaron and Gambhir was waiting for it, he is in such a frame of mind, goes for the pull, gets a top edge and it has gone away for a six!
outside the off stump, pitched up and dug out to third-man for a single
outside the off stump and pitched right up, Gambhir wanted to go for the drive, the bat jams hard into the ground and he misses the shot, through to the keeper
full-toss, on the middle stump, pushed to the right of the bowler, to mid-off for a single
pitched up again, on the middle stump, wanted to flick it away and hard over square-leg, but the shot goes finer and to the fielder
full ball, into the middle stump and McCullum is able to flick it away to deep square-leg for a single
short of length, on the pads, flicked away to square-leg and before the fielder can get across and have a shy at the stumps, the batsmen are through for a single
inside out for four, over extra-cover! It was pitched up and was angling away from Gambhir, he takes his front foot out and slams it over the extra-cover for a boundary
pitched right up but on the middle stump, punched back to the bowler, who misfields on his left and the batsmen are able to run away for a single
pitched up but slightly closer to the stumps, wants to drive it away, but goes straight to covers
down the pitch and carved away through point for four, excellent shot from the captain, taking his chances early when the ball is coming on
short of length, wants to pull it away, goes hurriedly to mid-on, Yadav fields well and throws at the non-striker's end, misses again
round the wickets, angling in, pitched up, Gambhir goes for a drive and for the second time in this innings he gets an outside edge through to third-man for a single
pitched slightly up, he was on the back foot, dabbed away to off side, Warner got a good bounce and was lining up to throw the stumps down, but wait, he fails to hold on to the ball!

wants to swing it away, it is short of length and McCullum misses the shot, hits his pads, and there is a loud appeal from the bowler, Doctrove shakes his head. Seemed to have hit outside the off stump and was probably going over
length ball on the off stump, McCullum was pushing forward and in the end, defends it to the off side
fuller this time, change of length, driven back by McCullum but without too much timing, back to the bowler
outside the off stump, short of length and he has cut it away, or at least attempted it and the top edge goes over the slips for a four!
on his pads, this time he does not go down the track, moves to the off stump to flick it away but hits the pads
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, goes for a drive, gets an outside edge and it absolutely flies away to third-man for a single
and again, goes down the pitch, its fuller but angling into the bat, drives it to mid-off
short of length this time, not really a bouncer but the batsman had to go back in crease and tucks it away to backward square-leg, runs away for a quick single
short ball and Gambhir has gone for the pull, hits the middle of the bat and it's sailed away over fine-leg for a six!
short of length, outside the off stump, cut to Negi at covers, they went for the single and the fielder had time to line up and shy at the stumps, misses and Gambhir survives
outside the off stump, driven through the covers, almost, almost pierces the in-field but Jayawardene at short cover dives to his left to save it, only a single off the ricochet
outside the off stump and cut away, the fielder in the covers dives to his left to stop it, was going quickly too
outside the off stump, wider as well and McCullum wanted to cut it away, gets it point only
short of length again and punched back to mid-off, no run for the batsman
short of length this time, but outside the off stump, lets it go, wide called which does not make the bowler too happy.
down the pitch and four! He has been doing that all the time so far this over, it was pitched up this time and he has been able to slam it back over the bowler's head
swing back in again, he was down the track too, pushes it to the off side
jumps down the track, does that rather early and Pathan shortens the length outside the off stump, almost chops it back on
pitched right up, swinging back into the batsman, he is on the front foot and drives it back to Pathan
slightly shorter again and Umesh flat-bats it to long off. Kolkata Knight Riders have qualified for the finals of IPL 2012. It's the first time in five seasons that they have got this far.
Irfan pulls the hat-trick ball through square
caught at cover! Narine's filling his bag here. Morkel goes back and slogs at a sharp offbreak, he slices it and the ball lobs to Bhatia on the edge of the circle

stumped. Negi steps out and moves outside leg stump to slog wildly. Narine slowed it up, beat the left-hander in the flight, and spun the offbreak past the bat. McCullum had time to break three sets of stumps
Irfan pulls again, but this time to fine leg for a single
slightly short and Irfan rocks back and pulls the ball into the gap on the wide long-on boundary, a poor start for Narine
Negi makes room and cuts a full and wide ball into the ground and over point, the ball races to the boundary

caught at deep backward square leg! The ball was fuller and straighter, on middle and leg, Taylor flicked it off the pads but he hit it low and in the air. The ball was dipping on the fielder on the boundary and he had to move forward and stoop to catch it
the slower, shorter ball. Taylor pulls towards cow corner

another full and wide ball outside off, just inside the tram line, it was slower as well. Taylor tries to play the big booming drive but makes no contact. Kallis is keeping the ball far away from Taylor's hitting zone, towards deep midwicket
full length outside off stump and quite quick too, Taylor had made room towards leg so was unable to reach it
a full delivery outside off, Negi hits the ball hard past the bowler, who sticks his right boot out to try and stop the ball
hit hard off the back foot to wide long off for two more
whoa! Narine's been hit for six! Taylor receives a full ball and so he can get underneath it and slam it over the wide long-on boundary
that's the one that spins away from the right-hander and Taylor tried to slog sweep from outside off, he was beaten
Negi backs away and slices the offbreak in the air towards short third man, where Kallis dives forward but can't reach the catch
Negi charges and tries to slog on the leg side, the offbreak spinds sharply away from the left-hander and he mis-hits towards the bowler
a quickish ball outside off, Taylor cuts off the back foot to short third man
Kallis ends a great over with one in the blockhole outside off, the batsman gets beaten on the steer

Venugopal's struggle ends, and he has struggled. Kallis banged in another short ball, the batsman backed away and tried to swat over the off side. The top hand came off the bat and he mis-timed it tamely in the air to cover

another short ball, Venugopal tries to hook but misses, there was a noise as the ball passed the bat and Kallis appealed for a catch behind. The ball clipped the bat but the umpire did not hear or see it
the slower bouncer but it's a bit too high
in the blockhole around off stump, Negi backs away and digs it out towards mid off
Venugopal tries to pull a short ball that hurries on to him and top edges towards fine leg, that was too quick for the right-hander
that is far too full to be moving towards leg and slogging across the line, Venugopal tries to but is beaten, the ball passes over the stumps
in the blockhole on middle stump, Venugopal plays towards cover point. Delhi needed 11 an over at the start of this one, they got 8 off it
beaten outside the off stump
Negi makes room and drives a full ball angling across him to the fielder on the cover boundary
Venugopal charges and hits a full toss to long off
driven to long on for a single

little Negi's played a lovely shot! Shakib fired the ball full and flat outside off stump from round the wicket, Negi stays back and opens the face, square driving the ball to the backward point boundary
driven off the front foot to cover
comes out of his crease and drives to cover

McCullum almost makes a crucial fumble but Mahela was so far out that he had time to recover and take the bails off. Massive, massive blow for Delhi. Mahela charged the left-arm spinner but Abdulla followed him and cramped him for room. Mahela swung across the line but missed and he was several steps out of his crease, giving McCullum plenty of time to gather the ball after the brief fumble. McCullum didn't actually drop the ball, just juggled it. A rare lapse in judgement from Mahela and it's cost him
makes room and then has to reach out for the ball outside off and slice over cover point
tapped off the back foot towards cover, where the fielder is on the edge of the circle
steps out of his crease again and drives inside out to long off
steps out of his crease again and drives to wide long off, Mahela says no to the second
Mahela goes back and cuts late, from close to off stump to short third man
mis-times the cut on the off side, tries to hit a bit too hard
Mahela gets down on one knee and sweeps to long leg
came down the track again and played to long on
comes out of his crease but then has to wait a while before the ball reaches him, ends up cutting to point
played off the back foot to point
Mahela tries to dab outside off but is beaten

Mahela goes back and taps it late towards midwicket, there's no fielder in the circle there so Narine has to chase himself, he gives up as the fielder from the deep comes sprinting in. Venugopal called for the second and he was struggling to make it back but the throw was not good
played off the back foot towards point
hit firmly over the bowler's head, it won't reach the boundary though
has that been dropped? It was. Venugopal tries to dab outside off and got a bottom edge, McCullum grabbed at it but grassed it. Narine could have had an impact rightaway
tries to sweep from outside off stump but mis-hits it towards short third man
played off the back foot towards mid-on
defended on the front foot
Mahela has a map of the field in his head. He moves towards the off side, gets down low and scoops the  ball between the keeper and short fine leg
defended on the off side
Venugopal tries to sweep but makes poor contact, an inside edge on to the pad
Mahela has room outside off and he waits on the back foot to cut extremely late, placing the ball between short third man and backward point
fuller ball on middle stump, driven to long on
good length but the line is on leg stump, Venugopal misses the glance and is hit on the pad
beaten outside the off stump
cut away and to the point fielder! Slower, very short and that could have been spanked away for a four, instead, he hits it straight to the fielder and Gambhir has an easy catch!
on the middle stump, pushed to the off side
shot, four more, and that is one of the best you will see, it was another of those quicker ones, just chipped it over the bowler's head and that goes straight over for a four!
shorter this time and MJ has cut it away to the backward point fence for a four, bisects the point and short third-man fielder very easily. Pathan gave chase to no avail
round the stumps, flatter again, pinned on the back foot, hits the pads, appeal for lbw not given
goes down the track, on his pads, misses the shot, but they are still able to rush away for a leg-bye
short of length, quicker too, pulled away to the fielder at deep mid-wicket
short of length, hits hard back at the bowler, who struggles to field it, does a decent job in the end
on the pads and pushed away to wide mid-off for a single
slower one on the leg stump, was lining up to go over the top, gets an inside edge to the deep square-leg boundary for a single
shorter from Bhatia and that has been pulled away to deep square-leg for a four! The fielder was inside the circle, Pathan dives over the ball and it rolls away
and there comes the slower one, he shimmies down the track and cuts it away to deep point for a four!
outside the off stump, bit if movement away, wanted to flay at it but misses the outside edge
outside the off stump, tries to cut away, but goes in the air to backward point for a single
another one which is quicker and flat, cut attempted but goes to point and there isn't a chance for a single
another one outside the off stump, no turn so far for Abdulla, cut away to backward point for a single
on the middle, driven to long-on, they wanted a second but the batsmen decide against it
wants to paddle it away, thought he gave his hand away by doing that early and the bowler saw it, mistimed to short fine-leg
on the off stump, quicker, flatter, cuts it to deep cover for a single
outside the off stump, fuller, goes on to the back foot and cuts it gently to point
outside the off stump, short of length again and he cuts hard at it, gets an outside edge through to fine third-man for a four
bouncer again, another one of them, outside the off stump, wanted to pull it away, falls short of the fielder at short mid-wicket
another one, bouncer, Ojha was fending at that, on the middle, cramped for room, hits on gloves!
bouncer, wanted to pull him away but misses, plonks him hard on his shoulder!
appeal from the bowler for a caught behind and the umpire calls it a wide, was there a glove on that one? Replays suggest it has flicked the thigh pad
short of length, on the off stump, goes on to the back foot, played away to third-man for a single
on the off stump, played away to the left of point for a single
on the off stump, bit of turn into the batsman, defended back to the bowler
pitched right up to the bat, wanted to swing it away and misses, it was spinning away from the bat and there was a lot of bounce too, misses the stump
short of the length, drifting in and pushed to the leg side for a single
pitched slightly up, wants to sweep it, gets a top edge and it goes into the gap between long-on and mid-wicket
on the off stump, pushed to the off side to a delivery that was spinning away from the bat
on the off stump, defended back to the bowler
on the off stump, defended to the off side but sent back again
on the middle stump, MJ's on the back foot, flicked away to square-leg, "No, No" they say
tries to adjust the line, bowls slightly down the leg side and an easy wide
down the track, it was outside the off stump and that has crashed through point, hits the absolute middle of the bat and beats the point fielder with ease!
short of good length, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
quicker, angling in from short of length, wanted to flick it away, does not get anywhere near the middle and it pops right in front
short of length, on the middle stump, wanted to pull it away, misses and hits the pads, they are off for a leg-bye
and this time he has been tonked over the bowler for a six, what a shot against the best all-rounder in the world, it was pitched up and the batsman went down the track and smashed it over long-off
inside out yet again and another four for Delhi, outside the off stump, not too much turn, and the batsman was easily able to hit it over
comes down the track, drives almost on the full to short cover
round the stumps, angling in and tries to sweep it, misses and there is an appeal, the umpire wasn't interested. Could have been going down
inside out and that is MJ's class, outside the off stump and the batsman moves away and hits it over extra-cover for a four!
outside the off stump, defended to the point fielder

beaten again despite the obvious struggles with the hamstring, it was outside the off stump, tries to defend it, misses and that is the end of an excellent over from Balaji. He is off the field though now.

on the off stump, and swinging away from the batsman, that is a lot of seam on a track called a spinners' paradise, beats the outside edge. Balaji feeling his hamstring immediately after that delivery
on the off stump, pushed to the off side and to the covers fielder
bounce and beaten! short of length, and it rises from there, the batsman was prodding at it, misses and through to the keeper. Leapt up that brute!
on the middle stump, swinging slightly away, defended on the leg side, and they are off for a quick single
edged and gone! Two wickets in two balls, Delhi in trouble, outside the off stump, swinging a little away, tries to cut away to point, gets an outside edge through to the keeper

appeal for inside-edged and catch..That was round the stumps, spinning into the batsman, it loops up and is caught by the keeper. Replays show that the ball hit the pads, the bat hit the pads but the bat and the ball did not make any contact, so not exactly a great decision by Doctrove.
outside the off stump and smacked over the long-on fielder for a six, the width allowed him to swing the bat and he gets the six
pitched up and defended back to the bowler
turn and four, all byes! It was on the middle stump and turning into the left hander, Warner was going for a biggie and it turns into the bat, beats him and the keeper!
on his pads, from round the stumps, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
on the back foot to a short of length ball, flicked away to mid-wicket, he takes a single, but there is an overthrow and the batsmen are able to come back for the second
on the middle stump, flicked away to the fine-leg for a single, strangely not too many changes of pace from Balaji in his first over
on the leg stump and this time the swing takes it away from the batsman, missed by Warner and wide called by the umpire Taufel
flays away to third-man, goes on the bounce to Narine at third-man and they get only a single, it was hit rather aggressively by Sehwag as is his wont!
on the middle stump, short of length, wants to flick it away but he is jumping while playing that stroke, gets a bit of the bat to square-leg for a single
shorter, quicker, Sehwag was on the back foot and fends it away to square-leg for a single
outside the off stump and edged away to the boundary! First ball and cut away for four, he wanted to cut it through point but it went fine and over the slip for a four
on the leg stump and swinging too, hits the pads and is nudged away to square-leg for a leg-bye, they are away
